content:
- Model consistently underestimates true price movements, especially after sentiment spikes (e.g., sentiment > 0.00 indicates bullish bias, but model fails to capture magnitude).
- Forecast shows gradual upward drift without sufficient momentum, while true outcomes exhibit sharper, often delayed spikes (e.g., 30d forecast peaks at ~75.08 vs true at ~89.37).
- After a spike in sentiment (e.g., 0.50 on 2022-11-29), model underreacts — forecast remains flat while true price rebounds sharply.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: overestimates short-term stability, fails to anticipate volatility or sharp reversals.
- Forecast lags true price by 2–5 days in upward trends; correction needed to align with sentiment-driven momentum.
- Overshoots after initial spikes (e.g., 2022-11-23: forecast peaks at 75.08, true peaks at 89.37) — model overconfident in linear trend.
- Sentiment history with 0.00 values suggests model should not overreact; but when sentiment rises, model underreacts — need to scale forecast upward with sentiment intensity.
